Q1. Which exact part of this repository should be changed?
Choices:
A. A workflow file under `.github/workflows/`; I will name the exact file in `/answer`
B. A script/helper under `scripts/`; I will name the exact file and function/symbol in `/answer`
C. Documentation/guidance only (`README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, or runbook prose); I will name the exact file in `/answer`
D. Another specific file/path/function I will name explicitly in `/answer` (RECOMMENDED)
Q2. What is the concrete problem with that target today?
Choices:
A. Something is broken or incorrect; I will describe the current behavior and the expected behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Something is flaky, slow, or noisy; I will name the workflow/job/log symptom or metric that is bad
C. Something is unclear or hard to maintain; I will name the exact pain point
D. Something is missing; I will describe the desired end state
Q3. What should count as "done" for this issue?
Choices:
A. A before/after scenario or reproduction I provide should pass after the change (RECOMMENDED)
B. A specific workflow/job/log symptom should disappear
C. A specific file/output/documentation change should exist afterward
D. A short acceptance checklist I provide in `/answer`
